{New addons typically have to be added to default groups to be registered}

Addons.Description: The list of addons in this group

TetherTo.Description: Attach these addons to specified addon groups
Notes: Used to add seamlessly to other addon groups without overriding them.
A size greater than 1 will ignore tacbar

Bullet.Description: The physical model of the projectile

Flare.Description: The particle effect emited when firing

Casing.Description: The casing ejected with each shot

Hit.Description: The effect when hitting a character

Deflect.Description: The effect when deflected by a melee weapon

Accuracy.Description: The natural accuracy of this weapon

Notes: Adds to ammo type

Damage.Description: The additional amount of damage this weapon provides

Recoil.Description: The amount of recoil control with each shot

DoT.Description: A damage over time effect applied to a character.

Effect.Description: The visual particle effects of this explosion.

Crater.Description: The decal applied to the surface where this explosion occurs.

ExplosionSound.Description: The sound path for the explosion.

Damage.Description: Maximum amount of damage this explosion emits from its epicenter

DamageType.Description: Damage from explosion is registered as this type.

Execution.Description: An execution performed on a target

Block.Description: The sound to play when blocking an attack

Drop.Description: The sound to play when dropping the wepaon

Swatch.Description:
A collection of color swatches that can be applied to armor and characters.
(Automatically added to the Fence)

Name.Description: The full name of this swatch
Notes: Displays in store

NameShort.Description: The shorthand name of this swatch

CanBuy.Description: If true, swatch can be bought in this store

TokenCost.Description: The amount of boon tokens this swatch is worth

ColorPairs.Description: All primary/secondary color combinations available with this swatch

Colors.Description: All single colors available with this swatch

Character.Description: A base character, represents players, NPCs, and Bots.

Name.Description: The full name of this character.
Notes: Appears above character health bars

NameShort.Description: The shorthand name of this character
Notes: Appears in narration dialog and from serial number references.

Description.Description: A brief summary of this character.

Enabled.Description: If true, this character can be summoned in the Playground.

Notes: Appears below a character's name in the inventory menu.

Level.Description: The general danger level of this character.
Notes: Affects bribe cost, AI reflexes, aggression of attacks, and sniper aim time
Warnings: Characters < 5 not elligible to be squad leaders

TacBar.Description: Multiplier for this character's tac bar.

Scale.Description: The physical size scale of this character.
Notes: Affects chosen executions, and madness mode health reduction

Speed.Description: The base speed properties of this character.

Toughness.Description: Inherit amount of armor points this character has

Health.Description: The amount of health this character has with every corpus block

Notes: The last one in the list is the first corpus block to be broken

Warnings: Sub-attributes are automatically derived from these values.

ArmorHead.Description: The amount of armor points this character has on the head.

ArmorBody.Description: The amount of armor points this character has on the torso.

Warnings: Must have all valid bone names for animator

AltModels.Description: List of all model parts to apply to this character.

AltMaterials.Description: List of all materials to apply to this character.

Reskins.Description: Replaces all materials on this object with the following.

TintsSecondary.Description: List of tints to apply at random to the torso and feet

TintEffect.Description: The colors of this life/death effect.

AnimationSet.Description: The animation profile of this character

Uniform.Description: A set of armor that matches specific colors and styles.

Traits.Description: A list of traits this character has.

MaxEnemyMult.Description: Multiplier for the maximum amount of enemies in a stage
Notes: True enemy count affected by stage tier, and current wave

EnemySquadMult.Description: Multiplier for the maximum amount of enemies per squad
Notes: True enemy count affected by stage tier, and current wave

ReturnOnWin.Description: Where in HQ the player ends up after winning the stage.

ReturnOnDie.Description: Where in HQ the player ends up after dying.

ReturnOnQuit.Description: Where in HQ the player ends up after leaving, or failing the stage.

DeathIsFake.Description: Ignore Return location on death, use Quit instead

SceneOnWin.Description: Go to this scene if you've beaten the stage

DoorOnWin.Description: Serial number of door to enter scene if you've beaten the stage

PrereqStages.Description: Required stages to complete all checkpoints before playing this stage

WorldChangeOnVictory.Description: Adds this save record to the attached career.

MaxHirelings.Description: An override limiter of how many hirelings you can bring in an arena
Warnings: This does not affect the hard limit of your squad size defined by your headquarters

TrooperOverride.Description: Override reinforcement replacement for this stage, chosen by upgrade tier.
Warnings: Additional tiers are redundant unless modded with a plugin.

TrooperChatterOverride.Description: A random phrase for the first trooper deployed to say when summoned.

Notes: Completing all checkpoints completes the stage

InfiniteSequence.Description: The final checkpoint for this stage

IgnorePlayerDeathLoss.Description: Will this stage automatically fail when all playable characters die?

Snapshot.Description: The backdrop for this mission on stage selection

PrereqStages_ToSee.Description: These stages must be completed before the stage's overworld marker even becomes visible

AmHub.Description: Is this a Hub overworld meant for selecting other stages?
Notes: Stage name is automatically announced when entering this stage
If [WipeSquadOnVictory] was enabled on a connected stage, [RequiredCharacters] will be used.

NoSaveHub.Description: If [True], hub will not be saved as reload point in career
Notes: Hub can still be accessed via Stage Leave properties, but will not be considered a restore point
Useful for one-time intros and closing scenes

HubDifficulty.Description: Difficulty set when entering this Hub World

LinkedOverworld.Description: If not a hub world, return to this hub world after stage is complete

Leave_Default_ToStage.Description: Stage to exit to after all other cases

Leave_Default_ToDoor.Description: The door to exit to for this stage

Leave_NeverWon_ToStage.Description: Stage to exit to if this stage was never beaten before

Leave_NeverWon_ToDoor.Description: The door to exit to for this stage

Leave_Forbid_ToStage.Description: If this stage's [ForbidWorldChange] hasn't been fulfilled, go to this scene on completion
Notes: Used for the one-time flashbacks in between story mode overworlds

Leave_Forbid_ToDoor.Description: The door to exit to for this stage

Leave_Forbid_WorldChange.Description: The record change to be unfilled to go to the Forbid stage

Name.Description: The name of this campaign

StartStage.Description: The stage that this campaign will start on

Hubs.Description: The Hub worlds attached to this campaign
Warnings: All hub worlds must be registered as their own stage cards.

NoLoadScenes.Description: These scenes will not have a loading screen when loading.

ColdOpenScene.Description: The opening scene that plays for the first time you start a new campaign

ColdOpenDifficulty.Description: The difficulty of the cold open scene

MenuIcon.Description: The icon for selecting this campaign

LoadScreenTips.Description: The special loading screen tips for this campaign

UnlockLoadouts.Description: Loadouts and Wardrobes will not be locked to the default if mission hasn't been beaten

Loadout.Description: A selection of weapons typically used for character loadouts, or as a random selection of weapons to choose from

Name.Description: The name of this loadout
Notes: Displays in story stage selection menus

Weapons.Description:
The assortment of weapons to use.
Follows the following definitions when used as a story loadout

BorrowLoadouts.Description: If used as a weapon stockpile, include weapons from these loadouts also
Warnings: Only accepts loadouts of a later load priority

Name.Description: The name of this wardrobe

Gear.Description: Adds these armor pieces to the player character

Uniform.Description: Add these uniform pieces to the player character

EmptySlots.Description: Removes the armor pieces of these slots from the character

BonusCorpus.Description: Adds these corpus blocks to the player character

WipeDefaultCorpus.Description: Will replace the original character's corpus blocks with the Bonus Corpus

Origin.Description:
A starting disposition for the player character in Arena Mode
(Automatically added to origin selection)

Name.Description: The full name of this origin
Notes: Displays in the origin selection screen

NameShort.Description: The shorthand name of this origin
Notes: Displays as the player's title in the inventory menu

Description.Description: A brief summary of this origin
Notes: Displays in the origin selection screen

Imprints.Description: The amount of imprints required to unlock this origin

LinkedCharacter.Description: The character template to use for this origin
Notes: +1 added to health with every imprint after unlocking

Buffs.Description: List of bonuses to apply with this origin
Notes: Origin names and descriptions are displayed in origin selection screen

SkillFocus.Description: Allow origin to unlock focus skills from this skill tree
Notes: Also grants attribute bonus from purchasing related skills

SkillWeakness.Description: Prevent origin from unlocking Core 3 skills of this skill tree
Notes: Also prevents attribute gains from purchasing related skills

AttributeBonuses.Description: Add/Subtract attribute value from character template
Notes: +1 added to all with every imprint after unlocking

SpecialSkills.Description: List of starting skills attached to this origin

DefaultArmor.Description: List of default armor attached to this character

DefaultUniforms.Description: List of default armor with specific color/styles attached to this character

Swatch.Description: Specifies all unique color swatches gained from playing this origin
Notes: Colors are kept after imprinting

WarchestGear.Description: List of armor available to the character in the warchest

WarchestWeapons.Description: List of weapons available to the character in the warchest
